documentation.content: The Monday `weeklyPromptReview` (functions/README.md, "Weekly prompt review") did not produce its report (`prompt_review_failed`: `week`, `trigger` (`schedule` / `cli`), `reason` (`MALFORMED_ANSWER`, `BLOCKED`, `TOKEN_CEILING`, `TIMEOUT`, `MODEL_ERROR`, `MODEL_REFUSED`, `READ_FAILED`, `RESERVE_FAILED`, `CLAIM_FAILED`, `CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE`, `WRITE_FAILED`, `SETTLE_FAILED`, `BAD_WEEK`, `ERROR`), `answers`, `costMicroUsd`). Nothing user-facing is affected and no prompt was changed: the review is advice only. The failed report is in `promptReviews/{week}` with its counts and cost. Look at the reason, then run it again with `npm run admin -- judge review --run --week <week>` (a dry run) and `--apply`. A week skipped at the spend ceiling or while paused is `prompt_review_skipped`, not this alert.
